description:
Nanobeasts turns walking into a creature collection game.

Every step helps hatch new eggs, evolve Nanobeasts, and grow your research lab. Set a daily step goal, build streaks, unlock badges, and watch your collection expand as you move.

Inside Nanobeasts you can:
- Hatch and evolve creatures by walking
- Track steps, streaks, distance, calories, and active minutes
- Explore your growing Dex and revisit discoveries
- Review progress in a stats dashboard with badges and history
- Use reminders to stay consistent with your walking habit

Premium unlocks deeper collection progress, new weekly creature drops, custom lab colors, and Apple Health syncing for more complete tracking, including Apple Watch activity.

Nanobeasts is built to make walking feel more rewarding, more consistent, and a lot more fun.
